strongest_case: The v2 repair has a compelling narrow scientific core. The complete successful-trace compatibility construction supports exact integer capacities K_NONE=1/4 and K_P_ATOMS=1/2 for one shared deterministic policy over complete authorized byte-visible histories, whereas the current open-loop implementation cannot certify that estimand. Because no G1 scientific call has occurred, permitting exactly two SCIENTIFIC_VALID P outcomes with observed count 0 or 1 is a prospective correction that avoids rejecting connected memory for behavior the atom-only control can legitimately express; count 2 remains a diagnostic contradiction only after the actual traces are shown to instantiate the certified same-policy runtime class. The missing Stage-A hash is honestly disclosed, and fresh exact current bytes may form a new ratified governance basis without claiming recovery or equivalence. The repair can preserve the original single-fixture, 18-trajectory, 234-opportunity, at-most-234-dispatch, no-retry diagnostic and all original causal, validity, resource, review, and claim firewalls. It is not ready for consensus, ratification, implementation, canary, or GPU dispatch until the selector, observed-trace check, label semantics, stable projection, canonical renderer, dependency closure, aggregation placement, credit firewall, test crosswalk, and two-layer scope allowlist below are made exact.

concerns.statement: Resolve SYS-G1B-A01/D01 and BENCH-G1B-A06 by normatively adopting one exact selector and certificate contract: delete only the false K_P_ATOMS=0 eligibility predicate, select and seal the first otherwise eligible original candidate before capacity, and never reselect.
concerns.evidence: The proposal says selection precedes capacity but does not itself specify the replacement for the original R07 predicate. The resolved v1 rule is the minimal unbiased repair: hash-bind and materialize SOURCE_SEALED_THEN_LEXICOGRAPHIC_D11_MODULE_J_MODE0_P_MODE2, the complete source-derived candidate universe, original order and tie keys, rejected predecessors, and every non-capacity predicate; remove only K_P_ATOMS=0; seal the first otherwise eligible four-side manifest and trace before the evaluator can see hidden truth. The evaluator must then certify exact K_NONE=1/4 and K_P_ATOMS=1/2 for one total deterministic mapping from every complete canonical authorized history to its next legal phase output. It must enumerate every successful trace or an equivalent complete forest, compare history bytes rather than digests, replay one shared-policy lower bound on all registered sides, and use a separately implemented upper-bound checker. Any selected identity, order, tie, policy-domain, side-set, denominator, K_NONE, or K_P_ATOMS drift stops for a new intake; it never advances, reranks, hard-codes, or falls back to another candidate. T01 must include the proposal's false/authorized split, side-swap, hidden-bit, feedback, extra-action, fourth-return/ninth-action, scratch/citation, witness, and certificate mutations, and T05 must prove the selector delta is exactly this one deletion plus fail-closed branches.

concerns.statement: Resolve SYS-G1B-A04 and BENCH-G1B-A01/A02/D02 by making raw-trace same-policy conformance and an exact two-of-two SCIENTIFIC_VALID denominator prerequisites to every 0/2, 1/2, or 2/2 interpretation.
concerns.evidence: K_P_ATOMS=1/2 bounds one deterministic policy, not two per-side controllers or a stochastic/backend mixture. Synthetic count vectors alone cannot establish membership in that policy class. After both raw P traces are immutable, but before the capacity integer is joined to observed counts, independently reconstruct every exact model input including system/chat template, operation schema, target projection, authorized history, returned rows, public feedback, and controller-authored bytes. At each byte-identical input require identical raw output bytes and identical parsed operation; allow branching only after authorized input bytes differ. Bind exact model/tokenizer/decoding/backend/reset/runtime hashes, prove trajectory/side/opportunity identifiers and shared cache/process state did not enter cognition, and fail closed on any mismatch or nondeterminism. Both registered rows must be exactly SCIENTIFIC_VALID_SUCCESS or SCIENTIFIC_VALID_NONSUCCESS; MODEL_INVALID, INFRASTRUCTURE_FAILURE, RESOURCE_CEILING_EXCEEDED, CANCELLED, missing/duplicate rows, zero attempts, denominator drift, or manifest/capacity mismatch makes the construct control uninterpretable. Only after these checks may 0 or 1 pass the control range; 2 is an above-class diagnostic contradiction, not automatic leakage evidence.

concerns.statement: Accept BENCH-G1B-D01 over the systems interpretation: an observed 0/2 may not be labeled strict-control-clean, clean, nonleaking, information-free, or below chance.
concerns.evidence: An empirical failure count cannot prove absence of information or leakage, especially when the certified arm can legitimately solve one side. Cleanliness is established, if at all, by T01's policy-class certificate and T04's source/visibility noninterference evidence. T02 should use an observational label such as OBSERVED_ZERO_VALID_CONTROL for 0/2 and CAPACITY_ATTAINING_QUALIFIED_CONTROL for 1/2, with positive_method_credit=false in both cases. It must separately report the certified 1/2 structural capacity, exact side-resolved observed vector, and firewall status, and reject no-information, chance, reliability, probability, or population interpretations. This resolves the sole direct disagreement between the interpretations rather than preserving the proposal's scientifically overloaded label.

concerns.statement: Resolve BENCH-G1B-A07/D04 by adding a named post-freeze control-gate aggregator and a mechanical schema/linter firewall that makes P-ATOMS incapable of producing positive method evidence.
concerns.evidence: The matrix forbids CAPACITY_POLICY_WITNESS_AND_SCORE to OFFLINE_REDUCER, yet the declared gate requires a join between certified capacity and observed P counts. Preserve that separation: MODEL_RESOLVER freezes raw traces; OFFLINE_REDUCER independently replays D0 and assigns typed trace outcomes after each trace freeze while seeing no capacity artifact; only after the complete immutable gate ledger and all raw/reduced traces are sealed may POST_FREEZE_CONTROL_GATE_AGGREGATOR consume the selected-manifest ID, certificate hash and integer K_P_ATOMS, and the two typed P outcomes. It may emit the descriptive label and pass/stop result but has no edge to scoring, interventions, cognition, selection, dispatch order, cancellation policy, caches, timing, or positive-evidence computation. The report schema must side-resolve which P side succeeded and disclose any intervention-parent overlap. Mutation tests must swap [0,0], [1,0], and [0,1] while proving that every positive-evidence, efficacy, necessity, superiority, full-pass, headline, confidence, effect, and successor-authorization field remains absent or byte-identical; [1,1] may only set an uninterpretable diagnostic stop. GOLD plus replay/sham/cut/twin statements retain only their original narrow meanings, and no GOLD-minus-ATOMS contrast may be used as method credit.
